name: Terminal Management Action 5 Code
definition: Types of terminal management action to be performed by a point of interaction.

DCTV.name: Deactivate
DCTV.definition: Request to deactivate the element identified inside the message exchange.

DELT.name: Delete
DELT.definition: Request to delete the element identified inside the message exchange.

DWNL.name: Download
DWNL.definition: Request to download the element identified inside the message exchange.

INST.name: Install
INST.definition: Request to install the element identified inside the message exchange.

RSTR.name: Restart
RSTR.definition: Request to restart the element identified inside the message exchange.

UPLD.name: Upload
UPLD.definition: Request to upload the element identified inside the message exchange.

UPDT.name: Update
UPDT.definition: Request to update the element identified inside the message exchange.

BIND.name: Bind
BIND.definition: Request sent to a POI to bind with a server.

RBND.name: Rebind
RBND.definition: Request sent to a POI to rebind with a server.

UBND.name: Unbind
UBND.definition: Request sent to a POI to unbind with a server.

ACTV.name: Activate
ACTV.definition: Request to activate the element identified inside the message exchange.

DEVR.name: Device Request
DEVR.definition: Request to execute a device request.
